scenes.say: Have you ever run into a ClassNotFound error and wondered what’s behind it? Let’s break down class loading and classpath issues.

scenes.label: Hierarchy
scenes.sub: Bootstrap, Extension, and Application loaders work together to load classes at runtime.
scenes.say: The JVM uses a chain of loaders—bootstrap, extension, and application—to bring classes into memory. Each loader has its own role.
Most classpath headaches come from missing JARs, duplicate classes, or incompatible versions. These lead to errors and weird runtime failures.

scenes.title: Check your classpath setup
scenes.say: If you see a ClassNotFoundException, double-check your classpath setup. Make sure all dependencies are there and not conflicting.

scenes.question: What’s your first step for class loading errors?
scenes.wrong: Restart the JVM or redeploy the app
scenes.right: Inspect the class loader hierarchy and check for missing, duplicate, or incompatible classes in the classpath.
scenes.say: Don’t just restart or redeploy. Interviewers want you to inspect the loader hierarchy and check for missing or conflicting classes.
